description: Daniel Scott Sullivan; moved to Alaska in the 1990s.
Active 1993-1997 and 2004-2006; reserve 1997-2004 and 2006-2024, retiring as a colonel.
Served as the state's attorney general under governors Palin and Parnell.

role_or_event: Commissioner, Alaska Department of Natural Resources
description: Ran the state's resource-development agency under Gov. Parnell.
Assumed office January 3, 2015; serving alongside Lisa Murkowski.

role_or_event: Retired from the Marine Corps Reserve
description: Retired in early 2024 as a colonel after more than 30 years of service.
Announced at the Fairbanks Republican Women's Club Lincoln Day Dinner.
131,844 votes (45.80%); race called for Peltola on Nov. 17.
